timeline.evidence: Owner confirms the project started last month and is completed. Project-specific CHANGELOG.md entries begin September 27, 2026; the first Git commit is September 28. The source includes work through October 3. No exact build duration is claimed.

summary: A complete commerce platform for an Accra grocery business, connecting four counters with online shopping, hot meals, in-store sales, kitchen stock and delivery operations.
audience: Restaurants, caterers and resellers buying wholesale
Cashiers, kitchen staff, packing teams, dispatchers and riders

business.description: Harbour-direct fish sales grew into cold store, groceries, farm produce and hot meals under one roof.

implementedFeatures.name: Storefront and product detail
implementedFeatures.evidence: README.md; apps/web/app/(marketing)/shop; public shop and product pages inspected in a browser. Server filters, category counts, pack sizes, freshness and delivery estimates.

implementedFeatures.name: Shared basket and checkout
implementedFeatures.evidence: README.md; packages/api/modules/commerce; groceries and hot food, delivery or collection, GhanaPost GPS, slots, promotions and server-priced totals. Source-verified; no order or payment submitted.

implementedFeatures.name: Customer accounts and order tracking
implementedFeatures.evidence: README.md; packages/api/modules/account; orders, reorder, lists, addresses, business applications and privacy-limited public tracking.

visualDirection.portfolioTreatment: Existing reusable case-study layout with a navy-and-ice hero, alternating screenshot chapters and a desktop/mobile composition.

limitations: Source inspection verifies implementation; external payments, notifications and staff workflows were not exercised end to end.
The live hot-food menu and plate builder had no populated meals or ingredients during capture. The local preview showed the same empty menu.
Checkout was reached with a product in the browser basket, but its summary showed a retry state. No customer details, order or payment were submitted; this screen was excluded from the gallery.
Demo prices, delivery times, address and opening hours remain illustrative in README. Screenshots document UI, not performance or confirmed commercial terms.
No customer data, staff accounts, order records, credentials or measured business outcomes are included.
